messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — Acme pilot asked for GA-level SSO + EU data residency, and they want a firm trial window starting May 4.
jason: that's tight. our current v1 plan hits SSO + telemetry by June. can we move the SSO up and cut something else?
lucy: engineering capacity is maxed this sprint. we could either: 1) compress the analytics/observability surface, or 2) ship SSO in a limited-mode (no idp provisioning) for the pilot.
mike: limited-mode SSO + a canary rollout sounds safer. reduces infra churn and keeps the compliance ask mostly satisfied.
anya: proposal: for pilot (May 4-18) we deliver limited SSO + EU residency for customer data partitions. postpone detailed usage dashboards to v1. everyone ok?
jason: what's the risk to observability if we cut dashboards? any blind spots for SLA/latency during pilot?
lucy: we'll keep basic request/latency traces + errors. drop cost-by-route and deep funnel metrics. add an alert for 500s and p99 latency.
mike: add a temporary runbook: if p99 > 600ms for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets, fallback to smaller model variant. ops can flip flag.
anya: sounds good. need signoff from security (data residency) and legal (pilot terms) by EOD Friday.
jason: pinging @lucy for security check — are there any encryption/KMS blockers for EU partitions?
lucy: KMS regions are ready. only thing is key rotation policy doc — legal wants a clause. I'll draft it and upload to the pilot folder.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary pipeline for "pilot/eu-limited-sso" will run on 2026-05-01 02:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: action items: 1) lucy — draft key rotation clause (due Thu) 2) mike — runbook + fallback flag (due Thu) 3) jason — confirm telemetry subset and dashboard removal checklist (due Thu) 4) anya — update pilot T&Cs and notify Acme (due Fri)
jason: ack. I'll post the exact list of removed metrics in the product doc.
lucy: ack. security will review key clause and post comments.
mike: will add runbook to ops-docs and test the fallback locally.
anya: thanks team. if anyone hits a blocker, drop it here. otherwise I'll escalate the legal signoff if we don't hear back by Friday. :thumbsup:
